inspection_method: shallow git clone plus .github README/contribution guide, issue template, VitePress config, package scripts, feedback API route, feedback schema, markdown lint, single-page generation, and recently-removed generation scripts

anchors.why: Describes the site, backups, contribution paths, duplicate search expectation, and approved-change propagation.
Documents submission bans, duplicate checks, larger-change discussion, site testing, reporting, and editing workflows.
Requires issue type and context and repeats contribution/deduplication reminders.
Validates feedback, captures page/heading/type, applies rate limiting, and sends structured feedback to a webhook.
Generates a combined Markdown page used for whole-site duplicate/search workflows.
Uses git history to generate recently removed entries and deduplicate removals.
Checks link formatting, starred-entry formatting, invisible characters, slash spacing, broken syntax, and other directory conventions.
Configures VitePress, search, RSS, PWA, meta generation, markdown transforms, and build hooks.

known_limits: This is a high-risk public link directory; its content should not be imported into VAKS.
Community approval, stars, backups, or link presence are not evidence support.
Feedback routed to external chat/webhook systems is process input, not truth mutation.
